_note: What Dr. Yae says when the farmer talks to her away from her counter (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; the gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction; gift_items names her own answer to a keepsake or a dish (Talk.gift_line), by item or by dish:<reaction> (gifts in data/villagers/yae.json). She has no hearts, so no band rows past the first meeting. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Still here? Then sit a moment. Sitting is free.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: If you're looking for something to do, the shrine steps need nobody's help. Rest.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: My patient, up and about. Good. Bed before midnight, and eat something hot, please.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: I'm Yae, from the clinic by the smithy. Farmers I mostly meet lying down, so this is nice.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Keep it that way. Sleep early, and stop when your arms tell you to.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Hinata Clinic, east of the smithy. Herb tonic on the shelf, a bed in the back. Hope you need neither.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Wet days fill my waiting room: colds, slips, sore backs. Change out of those clothes.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Morning. Did you sleep? Really sleep, I mean, not just lie down and plan the field.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Drink water in this heat. Tea is nice, but water first.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Cold hands slip on a hoe handle. Gloves. I've stitched up enough thumbs this year.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Hachiro comes in with burns and says it's nothing. It is never nothing.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: A walk after lunch keeps a doctor honest. I'd tell my patients to do it, so I do it.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Tired is a message, not a weakness. Read it before it shouts.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Oh, this is just what I'd have prescribed.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Thank you. I'll have it tonight, after the last patient.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Good, honest food. Thank you.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: For me? That's kind. Thank you.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Sweets... I tell half the village to eat fewer of these. Thank you, though.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: A rock? I already have patients who dig in the mine. I don't need the souvenir.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: A health charm, for the doctor? Somebody at the shrine is laughing.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: I'll hang it over the sick bed. Every little bit of help counts in there.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Cooked at home, still warm. Better than any tonic on my shelf. Thank you.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: A proper meal. I'll eat it sitting down, for once.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: You cooked this? Then you're eating properly too. Good. Thank you.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: That much sugar in one bowl... I'll share it with the waiting room. Thank you.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: One gift a day is plenty. Doctor's orders.
